sentences: Near the bottom of this tall scroll a stone haetae peeks out between leafy trees, and beyond it rise the closed Gwanghwamun Gate and the halls of Gyeongbokgung Palace.
Half the picture belongs to Mount Baegak, today's Bugaksan, and the axis of the gate runs straight up to its peak.
The title means 'spring dawn at Baegak', and the low clouds and shut gate tell us it is very early morning.

An Jung-sik was chosen as a court painter for the royal portrait of 1902, and from 1911 he trained the next generation, including Yi Sang-beom and No Su-hyeon, at the Calligraphy and Painting Academy.
In 1915 he painted the same view twice, in summer and in autumn; this one is inscribed 'painted by Simjeon on a summer day in the eulmyo year'.
That year parts of the palace were being demolished or altered for a colonial industrial exhibition, yet he shows it whole and dignified, which many read as a quiet wish for independence.
Made at the request of the former royal household, the summer version passed from the Deoksugung museum to the National Museum of Korea and was registered as national cultural heritage in 2012.
